_doc: K6 test and first use: the private pier off Ogden Point (survey 6.14/6.15, docs/sites/bar-harbor-waterfront.md stretch 6). Level metres. 41 m x 3 m, deck +4.3 NAVD; the lidar's ground falls from +1.6 at the root to -1.1 at the outer end (height_root_m 2.7, height_m 5.4 below the deck). The charted head 6.15 (6 x 7 m) is absent from the 2021 lidar, flown out of season: a seasonal float on a gangway (summer_only). Rails at +5.3 match the lidar's raised edges. Timber or aluminium waits on photo V6.2.
